units.name: Upper etched unit
units.description: Indurated, rugged, moderately-to-heavily cratered, light-to-intermediate toned unit located along and on the northern Jezero crater rim and wall, along the interior margin of Jezero crater, and throughout Nili Planum. Overlies units Nnp1 and cr in Nili Planum and conformably overlies unit Nle in Jezero crater. Contains three different surface expressions with varying morphologic and erosional textures that grade into one another without clear or systematic stratigraphic contacts: a ridged expression in northern Jezero and northeastern Nili Planum, a heavily cratered expression in northern Nili Planum, and a light-toned rugged expression in southern Nili Planum (Figure 3). Type area: lat 18.67Ã‚Â°N, long 77.57Ã‚Â°E and lat 18.68Ã‚Â°N, long 76.86Ã‚Â°E and lat 17.77Ã‚Â°N, long 76.86Ã‚Â°E respectively.

units.name: Jezero floor unit
units.description: Rugged, moderately-to-heavily cratered, light- to dark-toned, planar unit with margins defined by low-relief, sharp, lobate scarps, forms the central portion of the Jezero crater floor and overlies and embays units Nue and Nle, respectively. Most impact craters on this surface are <200 m. Can have dark, smooth surface texture, especially near contact with unit NHjf2. Type area: lat 18.43Ã‚Â°N, long 77.65Ã‚Â°E.

units.description: Rugged, lightly cratered, light- to intermediate-toned unit concentrically exposed on the floor of Jezero adjacent to unit Njf. Topographically lower than adjacent unit Nue.
